title: A 13-kb Deletion in SeAPRR2 Disrupts Chloroplast Development by Dual-Targeting SeHEMA1/SeLHCB4 for White Peel Formation in Chayote.
authors: Cheng, Shaobo; Su, Lihong; Yan, Wei; Chen, Zhili; Zhou, Xiaoting; Li, Qingming; He, Chaoxing; Zhang, Zhiqing; Wu, Hejun; He, Zhongqun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SeAPRR2转录因子通过结合SeHEMA1/SeLHCB4启动子调控叶绿体发育，涉及TF-DNA结合验证，但以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟方法仅分子对接辅助，深度不足。
abstract: Fruit peel colour is a critical quality trait in chayote, directly influencing its commercial value. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying peel colour variation remain poorly understood. In this study, we observed higher chlorophyll content in deep green peel (DGP), green peel (GP), and light green peel (LGP) compared to white peel (WP). Additionally, WP exhibited reduced chloroplast number and structural disorganisation, with metabolomics confirming the reduction of galactolipids (DGDG and MGDG) essential for membrane stability. Integrated transcriptomic, resequencing, and WGCNA analyses identified SeAPRR2 as a candidate gene controlling peel colour, with a ~ 13-kb deletion in WP responsible for the white phenotype. This deletion triggered downregulation of DEGs related to chlorophyll biosynthesis and photosynthesis pathways. DAP-Seq revealed that SeAPRR2 binds to the cis-element (AAT(G/C)ATT) in promoters. Through Y1H, DLR, GUS activity, EMSA, and molecular docking assays, we confirmed that SeAPRR2 activates the transcription of SeHEMA1 and SeLHCB4 via promoter binding. Heterologous overexpression of SeAPRR2, SeHEMA1, and SeLHCB4 in tomato significantly elevated chlorophyll content and increased chloroplast number. Collectively, this study establishes SeAPRR2 as a master regulator of peel colour through the SeAPRR2-SeHEMA1/SeLHCB4 module. The large-fragment deletion mechanism provides novel genetic insights for breeding colour traits in cucurbit crops.
abstract_zh: 果皮颜色是佛手瓜（chayote）中的一个关键品质性状，直接影响其商业价值。然而，果皮颜色变异的分子机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们观察到深绿色果皮（DGP）、绿色果皮（GP）和浅绿色果皮（LGP）中的叶绿素（chlorophyll）含量高于白色果皮（WP）。此外，WP表现出叶绿体数量减少和结构紊乱，代谢组学（metabolomics）分析证实了对膜稳定性至关重要的半乳糖脂（DGDG和MGDG）的减少。整合转录组学（transcriptomic）、重测序（resequencing）和WGCNA分析鉴定出SeAPRR2为控制果皮颜色的候选基因，其中WP中约13-kb的缺失导致了白色表型。该缺失触发了与叶绿素生物合成和光合作用途径相关的DEGs下调。DAP-Seq揭示SeAPRR2结合启动子中的顺式元件（AAT(G/C)ATT）。通过Y1H、DLR、GUS活性、EMSA和分子对接（molecular docking）实验，我们确认SeAPRR2通过启动子结合激活SeHEMA1和SeLHCB4的转录。在番茄中异源过表达SeAPRR2、SeHEMA1和SeLHCB4显著提高了叶绿素含量并增加了叶绿体数量。总体而言，本研究确立了SeAPRR2通过SeAPRR2-SeHEMA1/SeLHCB4模块作为果皮颜色的主调控因子。大片段缺失机制为葫芦科作物颜色性状育种提供了新的遗传见解。
